meta.title: Crownicles - A Multiplayer Role-Play Game for Discord
meta.description: Join the Crownicles adventure on Discord! Explore a medieval world, battle monsters, complete quests, and win the kingdom's princess's hand in this immersive multiplayer RPG.

game.welcomeText: You have just arrived in the kingdom. The roads are long and full of surprises. Use /report to begin your adventure.
game.finalText: You've had a taste of what Crownicles has to offer. Join thousands of players on Discord and write your own story!

events.text: A tree has fallen on the path and is blocking the way!

choices.label: Fell the tree and continue.
choices.outcome: Felling this tree took half an hour, but you manage to clear the path! You earn a few coins that were hidden under the trunk.

choices.label: Go another way.
choices.outcome: Going another way seemed to be a great decision — you found a shortcut and didn't waste any time!

events.text: As you pass a lake, you notice a man who seems to be having difficulties on his fishing trip!

choices.label: Offer your help.
choices.outcome: Thanks to you, the man catches a superb fish! To thank you, he offers you something that could be useful...

choices.label: Keep going, no time to waste!
choices.outcome: You don't have even a minute to lose to help a fisherman! You go your way and press on towards your destination.

events.text: As you get ready to enter a forest, a mysterious woman explains there is a shorter path through the west.

choices.label: Follow the advice of the mysterious woman.
choices.outcome: It was indeed a shortcut! You saved a lot of time and arrive at a village ahead of schedule.

choices.label: Cross the forest anyway.
choices.outcome: You get lost for several hours in the forest but find your way out unscathed. On your way out, you pick up an item that may be useful!

events.text: You stumble upon a traveling merchant who seems eager to make a deal!

choices.label: Browse his mysterious wares.
choices.outcome: Among the trinkets, you find a rare amulet that glows faintly. The merchant lets you have it for a fair price.

choices.label: Politely decline and move on.
choices.outcome: You wave goodbye and continue on your way. Sometimes the best adventures are the ones you choose to skip.
